core.title: Stainless Steel Sonoma Hand Forged Door Knocker, Acorn KMUJP

text.description_html:
Acorn KMUJP, Acorn Stainless Steel Sonoma Door Knocker

Imported from Europe, Acorn's Sonoma Stainless Steel Door Knocker is hand forged in stainless steel. The forging process darkens the hardware in an uneven pattern providing a natural finish similar to antique pewter. The simple beauty of the stainless steel finish coupled with the craftsmanship of the design will add opulent detail to any door. Hand forged, the KMUJP Sonoma Door Knocker is a modern day reminder of the times of old. Brilliantly hand crafted, this door knocker made by Acorn, will be sure to add a historic feel to any door. It may look like it comes straight from another century, but it is made to last.

Specifications of the Sonoma Hand Forged Door Knocker:

  • Finish: Natural Stainless Steel
  • Ring Height: 5-1/8"
  • Ring Width: 5-1/3"
  • Overall Height : 6-1/4"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Includes 5/8" Knocker Nail
  • Surface Mounted with Included Screws

Due to the handmade nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
